name: citadel_gold
source: citadel_gold, authored as 11 control points as the albedo of the citadel reference (citadel.jpg), in the order its spiral's regions alternate: a deep plum, a maroon, a dark umber, burnished then pale gold, a narrow cream near-white, a mauve haze and a dusky purple returning to the plum, so the map is cyclic; the gold and purple stops are a little more saturated than the reference's pixels, and the cream is held narrow, since a wide one floods the far field white.
